Experimenting with PAZ's, engulf to signal, FTR for entry. Small SL. approx 10:1 target. Just testing a theory about the puzzles pieces. Mainly based around decision and FL's which I have came to the conclusion are the same thing. Will write more about my thoughts when i can.

I drew my paz line wrong and so I was looking at the wrong FTR. This is what I should have been looking at (and check out the perfect QM level).

I suppose the is what if means when he says only trade the edges.

More of this to follow, I purchased FT2 at this weekend, yet to have time to play with it yet but I have lots to test.

I believe we to draw the paz's correctly we just need to follow the decisions when price was at a certain level. PAZ's change each time a new decision is made at a given price level. I believed this to be true a while a go but I couldn't quite get my head around it.

This is turning out to be a tough journey and there has been time I've thought it impossible, but the fact that so many of you are trading successfully has kept me going because I believe Everything is easy when you know how, I just needed to know how. PAZ's are literly the last piece of the puzzle.

As I flicked through a daily chart i realized how irrelevant timeframe actually is. Price is price on every time frame, the lower timeframes just allow us to really define the decision.

I also notice I was marking FL's, CP and flags and poles as I frew lines by my decsions points, I didn't actually have to go looking for them. If you only mark the last clean decision point you're defining all of your PAZ at once. I really someone out then understands what I'm saying or can confirm they see the same thing.

Not including the entry, I believe the chart below sums up where I'm at, If I was watching I the time I would have entered at the red line, great QM level at an FTR on the edge of a PAZ. That is what I want to be trading and that is what I'm going to base my testing around on FT2.

Good day to you all!

That's two trades now targeting about 9:1 each.

Ok, things I'm drilling in my head right now,

Take my trades from the edge of zones. If a zones is engulfed, look for an entry at the origin on the other side of the zone price has engulfed from. Targets should be the origin of price at the edge of a zone. If the origin and edge get engulfed, hold the trade and target the origin at the edge of the zone that has be engulfed. Or take profits and enter on the retrace targeting the edge of the next zone. practice defining zones and correctly defining the origin. Research the FTR of a FO, price seems to like to FO to this area.
